claims.text: Drug causes: nicotinic acid, systemic glucocorticoids, diethylstilbestrol, combined OCP, growth hormone, estrogen, protease inhibitors, niacin, injected insulin
claims.quote: These include the use of nicotinic acid, systemic glucocorticoids, diethylstilbestrol, combined oral contraceptive pill, growth hormone therapy, estrogen, protease inhibitors, niacin, and injected insulin.

claims.text: Once the offending drug is stopped, AN usually resolves
claims.quote: Once the offending medication is stopped, acanthosis nigricans usually resolves.

claims.text: Malignant AN may resolve if the causative tumor is removed
claims.quote: Acanthosis nigricans malignant may resolve if the causative tumor is removed successfully.
